verdicts.reason: A: the circle backdrop has come loose from the product and sits in the bottom-left behind the CTA. The CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, the badges wrap awkwardly with 'SUMMER ONLY' alone on a second line, and the body copy is tiny. The top 40% of the canvas is empty and the brand name sits below the headline, so the reading order is broken. B: it keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (brand, headline, product, copy, actions) with a large product and a readable headline. But the circle also comes loose and collides with the body copy and the CTA, the headline runs edge to edge with tight margins, and the CTA is no bigger than the badges, so its hierarchy is lost.
